title: TO01–TO13 development review
purpose: Read-only review of recorded program axes, measured summaries, registered paired comparisons, and rollback decisions. No TO14/15 outcome is included and no confirmation efficacy is inferred.

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO01: R26 fixed-reference boundary-control run; the API carries the final-label concept as a boundary control, but this run uses instantaneous teacher scoring. This is baseline/control provenance, not TO03 final-label treatment.
rounds.recorded_disposition: baseline/control; no TO-level parent contrast recorded

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO02: historical R11 matched-state-boundary control, preserving its virtual_mass=0.025; instantaneous teacher scoring remains in force. Keep historical R11 distinct from terminal-outcome round IDs.
rounds.recorded_disposition: baseline/control; no TO-level parent contrast recorded

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO03: replace instantaneous teacher targets with decoded-final family-mean labels on the R26 base; outcome binding appears in the compiled program. Initial test of retrospective final-label selection.
rounds.recorded_disposition: label-treatment run; no registered immediate-parent paired comparison in this summary

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO04: apply decoded-final mean labels on historical R11 base while preserving virtual_mass=0.025; paired comparison key is against R11 boundary-control (TO02), not TO03.
rounds.recorded_disposition: keep as development lineage, not confirmation

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO05: pool exact-copy alias/family credit before teacher ranking, with R11 mean library as parent; calculator and reward response test credit/ranking implementation, while measured performance remains prospective.
rounds.recorded_disposition: retain as interim family pooling step

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO06: deterministic family-first ranking before teacher selection; one family-level contrast avoids selecting a lucky duplicate. This becomes the quality fallback after later regressions.
TO07: first conditional matched spatial direction extension, leaving points/priors fixed. Historical matched support was sparse and this prospective run regressed versus TO06.
TO08: add observed family tail fraction to the mean utility at weight 0.5, with maximum-child reward excluded; this is an uncalibrated utility extension.
TO09: reduce only tail coefficient from 0.5 to 0.25; retain family tail credit and other parent values. Kept as the better development affinity choice after later regressions.
rounds.recorded_disposition: retained affinity development checkpoint / rollback base

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO10: expand teacher-library budget from 2 to 4 while retaining tail coefficient 0.25. Retrospective coverage increase did not translate into better measured all-slot affinity; rollback returned to TO09.
rounds.recorded_disposition: rollback to TO09 after negative primary paired mean

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO11: increase nearest teacher count from 4 to 6. Primary all-slot affinity regressed versus TO09; rollback record restores TO09. This is a failed round, not a promoted configuration.
rounds.recorded_disposition: rollback to TO09 after negative primary paired mean

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO12: restore TO09 and add count-regularization strength 2 to the observed tail prior, weight 0.25. This was selected as the affinity-first development candidate; not proof of efficacy.
rounds.recorded_disposition: restored after TO13 regression; affinity-first candidate pending new-batch confirmation

rounds.direction_and_reason: TO13: test only legacy instantaneous virtual_mass 0.025 to 0.0 on TO12 shrink2 reference. Both batch deltas were negative; rollback restored TO12 mass 0.025.
rounds.recorded_disposition: rollback to TO12; do not retain mass removal

cross_round_evidence_limits.historical_name_distinction: R11 and R26 denote historical program families in the compiled summaries; TO01–TO13 denote this experiment sequence. They are kept in separate fields.

label_and_censoring.interpretation: Observed ancestry only; extinct futures are unknown. Exact-copy pooling does not make clones or descendants independent.

decoded_final_mean_base_geometry.selection_method: Select evidence_items by explicit id.startswith(prefix); among selected entries, count and summarize only records carrying the requested p/q fields.
decoded_final_mean_base_geometry.effect_interpretation: Base decoded-final mean evidence contains 76 outcome/geometry p/q features; the two feature-level q<0.05 values have tiny stored proxy effects and do not define a causal chemical motif.

matched_family.selection_method: Select evidence_items by explicit id.startswith(prefix); among selected entries, count and summarize only records carrying the requested p/q fields.

support_item.matching: Distinct immediate parents, common grandparent, nearest online score, no pair reuse; equal families and batches

matched_family.effect_interpretation: The matched-family packet contains 137 selected p/q features, minimum corrected q 0.9753044394568644 and zero q<0.05; the support item records 266 total pairs and 152 supported batch-events. These are observational geometric proxies, not chemical interactions or causes.

continuous_trends.semantics: Descriptive temporal curve; derivative is not a coordinate force
continuous_trends.limitation: Descriptive temporal curves across repeated event times; not independent samples, causal estimates, or coordinate forces.

cross_round_evidence_limits.flowr_response: Reward-response artifacts report first-order FLOWR VJP changes at the learned score events; this is a local derivative response, not a second-forward measured reward change or measured affinity.
cross_round_evidence_limits.comparisons: Native and immediate-parent deltas are copied from each summary paired_comparisons entry; absent comparisons are null. No deltas were recomputed. The fixed two-batch developmental panel is adaptive and is not independent confirmation.

source_scope.compiled_paths: Each per-round compiled inference_config/reward_program.json and config.json path is recorded in its row; available matched requests/registries and rollback records are hash-bound in source_sha256.

prefix_and_verification_method.base_geometry: Read mining/family_mean_v2/evidence.json and select only evidence_items whose id starts with outcome/geometry/.
prefix_and_verification_method.matched_family: Read mining/matched_family_geometry_v1/evidence.json and select only evidence_items whose id starts with outcome/matched/. Do not reuse its inherited outcome/geometry/ entries as matched outcomes.
prefix_and_verification_method.support: Read the outcome/matched_support item from the same matched-family evidence packet.
prefix_and_verification_method.all_counts_p_q_support: Counts and extrema are computed by a Python script over the selected JSON records; no manual reconstruction or arithmetic from CSVs.
prefix_and_verification_method.round_summaries: For every TO01–TO13 row, reopen its referenced summary.json and compare all six displayed outcome metrics and the recorded native/immediate-parent paired comparison values directly to source fields. No deltas are recomputed.
prefix_and_verification_method.hashes: Recompute SHA-256 for every file-path entry in each row source_sha256 block and compare with the recorded digest.

original_draft_correction.issue: The draft populated matched_family from inherited outcome/geometry/* items in the matched packet. Those 76 records duplicate the base feature table and are not the matched-branch result.
original_draft_correction.correction: This verified file instead selects only outcome/matched/* entries (137 features); the actual matched support and q values are taken from the same matched-family packet.

verification.method: Recomputed SHA-256 for every existing per-round source path; compared each displayed summary metric and paired native/parent field to its actual summary.json; selected base and matched evidence records using disjoint literal ID prefixes and read support from outcome/matched_support.
